description: MAIN candidate packaging for the same verified native images; node and independent package acceptance remain pending. No publication authorized by this record.

before:
set -eu
mkdir -p /data/ui/state /data/node /data/pool/config /data/pool/www/pool /data/pool/www/users
chown -R 1000:1000 /data/ui /data/node /data/pool || true
chmod -R ug+rwX /data/ui /data/node /data/pool || true
after:
set -eu
mkdir -p /data/ui/state /data/node /data/pool/config /data/pool/www/pool /data/pool/www/users
# Core owns /data/node as bch2:bch2. Changing a running Core's
# database ownership here prevents writes and can force a restart.
chown -R 1000:1000 /data/ui /data/pool || true
chmod -R ug+rwX /data/ui /data/pool || true

before:
set -eu

apk add --no-cache envsubst jq >/dev/null

tpl_dir="/data/templates"

if [ -n "${JWT_SECRET:-}" ]; then
  envfile="/appdata/.env"
  tmp="/appdata/.env.tmp"
  if [ -f "$$envfile" ]; then
    grep -v '^JWT_SECRET=' "$$envfile" > "$$tmp" || true
  else
    : > "$$tmp"
  fi
  printf "JWT_SECRET=%s\n" "${JWT_SECRET}" >> "$$tmp"
  chmod 600 "$$tmp" || true
  chown 1000:1000 "$$tmp" || true
  mv "$$tmp" "$$envfile"
fi

mkdir -p /data/node /data/pool/config /data/pool/www/pool /data/pool/www/users /data/pool/cps/pool_configs /data/pool/cps/coins /data/templates

# NOTE: `/data/templates` is a persistent volume. Existing installs may not automatically
# receive new template files on app updates, so we must not hard-fail on newly added files.
if [ ! -f "$$tpl_dir/peercoin.conf.template" ] || [ ! -f "$$tpl_dir/ckpool.conf.template" ] || [ ! -f "$$tpl_dir/cps-config.json.template" ] || [ ! -f "$$tpl_dir/cps-peercoin.json.template" ]; then
  echo "Template files not found in $$tpl_dir. (Expected peercoin.conf.template, ckpool.conf.template, cps-config.json.template, cps-peercoin.json.template)"
  echo "Contents of $$tpl_dir:"
  ls -la "$$tpl_dir" || true
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$$tpl_dir/cps-coin-peercoin.json.template" ]; then
  cat > "$$tpl_dir/cps-coin-peercoin.json.template" <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "Peercoin",
  "symbol": "PPC",
  "algorithm": "sha256",
  "reward": "POW",
  "version_mask": "1fffe000"
}
EOF
  chown 1000:1000 "$$tpl_dir/cps-coin-peercoin.json.template" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ ! -f /data/node/peercoin.conf ]; then
  envsubst < "$$tpl_dir/peercoin.conf.template" > /data/node/peercoin.conf
  chown -R 1000:1000 /data/node || true
fi

# Self-heal older/invalid configs that enable multiple networks simultaneously.
# Peercoin refuses to start if both testnet and regtest are enabled.
cfg="/data/node/peercoin.conf"
if [ -f "$$cfg" ]; then
  if grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*testnet=1([[:space:]]*#.*)?$$' "$$cfg" && grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*regtest=1([[:space:]]*#.*)?$$' "$$cfg"; then
    echo "Found invalid Peercoin network flags (testnet+regtest). Removing both to default back to mainnet."
    sed -E -i '/^[[:space:]]*testnet=1([[:space:]]*#.*)?$$/d; /^[[:space:]]*regtest=1([[:space:]]*#.*)?$$/d' "$$cfg" || true
  fi
fi

needs_ckpool_regen=0
if [ -f /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf ]; then
  if ! grep -qE '"btcd"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\[' /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf; then
    needs_ckpool_regen=1
  fi
  if ! grep -q '"zmqblock"' /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf; then
    needs_ckpool_regen=1
  fi
else
  needs_ckpool_regen=1
fi

if [ "$$needs_ckpool_regen" -eq 1 ]; then
  existing_addr="$$(grep -oE '\\\"btcaddress\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\"' /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*\\\"btcaddress\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]*)\\\".*/\\1/' || true)"
  if [ -f /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf ]; then
    mv /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf "/data/pool/config/ckpool.conf.bak.invalid.$$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" || true
  fi
  envsubst < "$$tpl_dir/ckpool.conf.template" > /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf
  if [ -n "$$existing_addr" ] && [ "$$existing_addr" != "CHANGEME_PPC_PAYOUT_ADDRESS" ]; then
    tmp="$$(mktemp)"
    if jq --arg a "$$existing_addr" '.btcaddress=$$a' /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf > "$$tmp" 2>/dev/null; then
      mv "$$tmp" /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf
    else
      rm -f "$$tmp" || true
    fi
  fi
  chown -R 1000:1000 /data/pool || true
fi

if [ ! -f /data/pool/config/ckpool.args ]; then
  echo "-B" > /data/pool/config/ckpool.args
  chown 1000:1000 /data/pool/config/ckpool.args || true
fi

# Apply saved UI settings (if present) to ckpool.conf so payouts go to the configured address.
if [ -f /data/ui/state/pool_settings.json ]; then
  addr="$(jq -r '.payoutAddress // empty' /data/ui/state/pool_settings.json 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$$addr" ] && [ -f /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf ]; then
    tmp="$$(mktemp)"
    if jq --arg a "$$addr" '.btcaddress=$$a' /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf > "$$tmp" 2>/dev/null; then
      mv "$$tmp" /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf
      chown 1000:1000 /data/pool/config/ckpool.conf || true
    else
      rm -f "$$tmp" || true
    fi
  fi
fi

# cryptocurrency-pool-server config
if [ ! -f /data/pool/cps/config.json ]; then
  envsubst < "$$tpl_dir/cps-config.json.template" > /data/pool/cps/config.json
  chown -R 1000:1000 /data/pool/cps || true
fi
if [ ! -f /data/pool/cps/pool_configs/peercoin.json ]; then
  envsubst < "$$tpl_dir/cps-peercoin.json.template" > /data/pool/cps/pool_configs/peercoin.json
  chown -R 1000:1000 /data/pool/cps || true
fi
# Self-heal CPS vardiff settings so upgrades/mode changes cannot leave invalid
# values that cause runaway or excessively low share difficulty.
if [ -f /data/pool/cps/pool_configs/peercoin.json ]; then
  tmp="$$(mktemp)"
  if jq '
    if ((.ports["3333"] // null) | type) != "object" then
      .
    else
      .ports["3333"].varDiff = ((.ports["3333"].varDiff // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
      | .ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff = (
          (.ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff | tonumber? // 16) as $$m
          | if $$m < 16 then 16 elif $$m > 1048576 then 1048576 else $$m end
        )
      | .ports["3333"].varDiff.maxDiff = (
          (.ports["3333"].varDiff.maxDiff | tonumber? // 16384) as $$mx_raw
          | ($$mx_raw | if . <= 0 then 16384 else . end) as $$mx
          | if $$mx < .ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff then .ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff
            elif $$mx > 1048576 then 1048576
            else $$mx
            end
        )
      | .ports["3333"].diff = (
          (.ports["3333"].diff | tonumber? // (.ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff * 2)) as $$d
          | if $$d < .ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff then .ports["3333"].varDiff.minDiff
            elif $$d > .ports["3333"].varDiff.maxDiff then .ports["3333"].varDiff.maxDiff
            else $$d
            end
        )
      | .ports["3333"].varDiff.targetTime = (
          (.ports["3333"].varDiff.targetTime | tonumber? // 15) as $$t
          | if $$t < 8 then 8 elif $$t > 60 then 60 else $$t end
        )
      | .ports["3333"].varDiff.retargetTime = (
          (.ports["3333"].varDiff.retargetTime | tonumber? // 90) as $$rt
          | if $$rt < 30 then 30 elif $$rt > 300 then 300 else $$rt end
        )
      | .ports["3333"].varDiff.variancePercent = (
          (.ports["3333"].varDiff.variancePercent | tonumber? // 30) as $$v
          | if $$v < 10 then 10 elif $$v > 80 then 80 else $$v end
        )
    end
  ' /data/pool/cps/pool_configs/peercoin.json > "$$tmp" 2>/dev/null; then
    mv "$$tmp" /data/pool/cps/pool_configs/peercoin.json
    chown 1000:1000 /data/pool/cps/pool_configs/peercoin.json || true
  else
    rm -f "$$tmp" || true
  fi
fi
if [ ! -f /data/pool/cps/coins/peercoin.json ]; then
  cp "$$tpl_dir/cps-coin-peercoin.json.template" /data/pool/cps/coins/peercoin.json
  chown -R 1000:1000 /data/pool/cps || true
fi
